DDL	CREATE TABLE t1(col1 INT, col2 STRING)
PARSE_ERROR	DECLARE all = 1
SESSION	DECLARE a = 1
READ	SELECT col1, SUM(col2) FROM t1 GROUP BY ALL
READ	SELECT col1, SUM(col2) FROM t1 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
READ	SELECT col1, col2 FROM t1 ORDER BY ALL
READ	SELECT col1 AS a, SUM(col2) FROM t1 GROUP BY a
PARSE_ERROR	DROP TEMP VARIABLE a
PARSE_ERROR	DROP TEMP VARIABLE all
DDL	DROP TABLE t1
